log: Act VI in one piece, from the frozen end of Act V (she stands free in the house): the day after and Mira's leaving, the light in the house, the gap in the valley and the way back into Elysia, the garden, the market and the hall of mirrors, the inn with its three offers and the standing up, the rift that asks nothing, and the way home, where the host knocks and the act ends quietly. Nothing is set up: every flag, item and stage comes from the play (the soup comes from the host, the light from the house, the facet of the basin from the water)
the end of Act V: the house
Weiter begins the day after: a few lines of things, nothing is asked
the walk back begins
out into the valley
the old camp: Mira stands there with her bundle and says that she goes
she went her own way, over the bridge
the place where her tarp hung
back in the house
the house is quiet: a light that is not from here, for a breath
out into the valley, to the place where she arrived in the rain
the gap of light: she stands in it
she touches it: the look, five lines, and then the question
the five lines of the look, one click each (a wait would click through the question too)
the question stands on Stay: she moves to Going through
a step, the light, the black, and Elysia
the corner builds itself up, the garden as she left it
the gardener knew it before she was there, and holds out a compliment: she takes it (the first answer)
the basin: the first thing that gives nothing; she splashes the water (the first answer)
the gardener again: no second gift, a small word and a short talk
the welcoming ones: they offer before she asks
an Elysian on the way: the same sentences, the same walk
up the garden stairs to the market: the feast stands as she left it
the poet has just finished it: the verse that rhymes with itself (the first answer: again, word for word)
the festmaster: everything is ready, for the hero (the first answer: raise the glass)
the gatekeeper greeted her before she was at the gate
into the hall of mirrors
before the great mirror
it shows her, standing as she stands, and explains nothing (the first answer: keep looking)
she turns away: the Richter begins his sentence, and she is already on her way
the line broke off, he called after her, the game saved
out of the hall and in again: only here does he say the one quiet sentence
the quiet sentence, once
out of the hall, across the market and down to the garden again
into the inn: the host waits, the table in the middle is laid
the walk moves on from the garden to the inn
he waves with his whole arm as she steps up to the bar
the hearth: the dip in the carpet, the folded blanket, the bowl, the note (the why of his strategy, as a thing)
she sits down at the table in the middle: the first offer (soup), the second (music), the third (the quiet); every first answer is staying
after the third the game saves once; nothing was given, nothing taken
all three offers are behind her; she sits, and nobody holds her
she stands up by her own step: a key, never an answer in a menu
the host asks once, lightly, and lets go: the soup is on the table, and she takes it
the walk moves on from the inn to the standing
afterwards he is the same host, without an offer: the other half of a host's work, a thanks for the soup
out of the inn into the garden, and to the edge of the picture
the rift at the edge of the picture, where she found it once: she touches it, nothing is asked, and she takes one step
the corner lets her go, one piece at a time, the music runs out, black, the valley
the walk goes home from wherever it stood
the valley says what stands where the light stood
home: the door of the house
he knocks, comes in without a bowl and sits down at the fire; the drover reads the visit off the sheet
Elysia's song comes home
the act ends quietly: the mark of the chapter, no black, no title
he has nothing to offer: he sits
segment finished
